title: Research method for eGFR and SBP effector gene predictions (Sheng et al., 2021)
bodyHtml:
These results are from the study:

Mapping the genetic architecture of human traits to cell types in the kidney identifies mechanisms of disease and potential treatments.
Sheng X, Guan Y, et al.
Nat Genet. 2021 Sep;53(9):1322-1333. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00909-9..
PMID: 34385711

eQTLs were generated from tubule and glomerular samples microdissected from human kidneys. A cell fraction-adjusted model (eQTL(cf)) was used in order to take into account the cell population distribution of each sample.

eQTLs were then tested for colocalization (using coloc v3.2.1; Giambartolomei et al., 2014) with genome-wide significant association signals (after LD pruning) from the following GWAS:

  • estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR; Wuttke et al., 2019, Morris et al., 2019, Hellwege et al., 2019)
  • serum urate levels (Tin et al., 2019)
  • urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR; Teumer et al., 2019)
  • urinary sodium and potassium excretion (Pazoki et al., 2019)
  • systolic blood pressure (SBP; Giri et al., 2019)

Genes were prioritized as potential effectors for kidney function if their eQTLs colocalized with signals from the studies above. Genes were prioritized as potential effectors for systolic blood pressure if their eQTLs colocalized with SBP signals (Giri et al., 2019).
